Summary: Checks the security of a Twilio SendGrid account: every authenticated domain is validated (DKIM and DMARC alignment), API keys have least privilege, Enforced TLS is on, and subusers and dedicated IPs are in the EU. Reads only, through the SendGridTools module. Limit: global SendGrid API only; EU regional accounts (api.eu.sendgrid.com) cannot be checked.

Prerequisites.Text: A SendGrid API key with Restricted Access and read scopes only: whitelabel.read, api_keys.read, user.settings.enforced_tls.read, subusers.read, ips.read. A test whose scope is missing is skipped and says so.
Maester installs the SendGridTools module 0.4.7 from the PowerShell Gallery with the pack.
Limit: SendGridTools 0.4.7 reaches only the global API (api.sendgrid.com). An EU regional account or subuser (api.eu.sendgrid.com) cannot be connected.

Commands.Text: Run the pack on its own.

Options.Name: MaximumScopes
Options.Text: MP.WEY.SENDGRID.1002: the most scopes an API key may have.

Options.Name: RequireValidCertificate
Options.Text: MP.WEY.SENDGRID.1003: also require a valid certificate from receiving servers.

Options.Name: MinimumVersion
Options.Text: MP.WEY.SENDGRID.1003: the lowest TLS version SendGrid may use.

Options.Name: MaximumIps
Options.Text: MP.WEY.SENDGRID.1004: the most dedicated IPs read (one page).

AppOnly.Text: Runs unattended with the key in the MAESTER_WEY_SENDGRID_API_APIKEY environment variable. No Microsoft sign-in is needed.
